ارتكمن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَمْنَ (irtakamna) /ir.ta.kam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# اِرْتَكِمْنَ (irtakimna) /ir.ta.kim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
